title: Hex dependency overrides the resolved version
description: mix.exs declares an `override: true` flag that pins a version across the tree. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `override: true` flag that pins a version across the tree.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix an `override: true` flag that pins a version across the tree.
limitation: It matches an `override: true` flag that pins a version across the tree in the parsed mix.exs; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
